title: 1.44 - Annealing oven
description: Electrical input, moving steel and three heat-loss paths.
exercises: Inspect the rectangular control volume and each named surface.
Check the supplied values, or mark electrical input unknown and solve its balance.

title: 1.51 - Melting frost
description: Frost/air interface, incoming convection and latent storage.
exercises: Inspect the explicit 1 m² area and 40 W/m² convection input.
Mark storage unknown to recover 40 W. The submitted melting time is an annotation, not a transient solver result.

title: 1.57a - Oven wall
description: Solid wall with surface temperatures, outward heat paths and its resistance network.
exercises: Inspect the cross-section and its linked resistance network.
Check the submitted temperatures and rounded resistances, or choose a resistance unknown.

title: 1.60a - Hot plate
description: Steady-state electrical input with parallel convection and radiation.
exercises: Check the supplied 200 °C plate, 25 °C surroundings and 188.6 W input.
Choose Plate temperature or a resistance unknown, then solve and compare with the saved answer.
